name: Agamand Family Crypt
summary: The Scourge has seized the Agamand Family Crypt just north of Agamand Mills. Once the resting place of Tirisfal's wealthy farming dynasty, its tombs now hold ancestors raised by Captain Dargol as mindless terrors.

sections.title: Restless Ancestors
sections.body:
The Agamand family once held broad estates across northern Tirisfal Glades. Their ancestors rest in a hillside crypt, until the Plague ruined the kingdom and Captain Dargol seized the tombs for the Scourge.

Through dark necromancy, Dargol awakened the Agamand dead as vengeful skeletons and apparitions. Their restless forms make the family burial ground a Scourge foothold beside Forsaken territory.

faq.q: Where is the Agamand Family Crypt located?
faq.answer: The crypt is carved into a hillside just north of Agamand Mills, in northern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Who controls the crypt right now?
faq.answer: Captain Dargol controls the crypt for the Scourge and commands its raised dead.

faq.q: What will I encounter inside the crypt?
faq.answer: Awakened skeletons and vengeful spirits of the Agamand ancestors fill the crypt. Dark magic drives them to attack anyone who enters the tombs.

faq.q: Are the undead inside the crypt allied with the Forsaken?
faq.answer: No. The dead serve the Scourge under Captain Dargol and are hostile to Forsaken and living travelers alike.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you face an intolerable Scourge presence in Tirisfal. Captain Dargol's occupation mocks the dead and threatens the Undercity's northern frontier.
